use_case: Dynamic ticket pricing: raises or lowers the price of each price level for reserved-seat Hall shows as demand changes, within company-set limits
vendor_or_model: Ticketing platform vendor (machine-learning demand forecast module in SYS-01)
source_evidence: EV-032 (module settings and change history); EV-026 (vendor system description); EV-062 (P10 input test)
data_categories: Aggregate sales velocity, seats remaining, days to show, page views, queue size, floor and ceiling settings; no patron-level data (tested)
consequential_decision_category: None (same price for every buyer at a given time); re-tier High if patron-level data is ever used to set prices
human_in_the_loop: Today none (auto-apply). Condition: floors and ceilings per show with artist caps; approval queue for changes over 25% in 24 hours; accessible seating removed from auto-apply and set daily for parity
applicable_laws: 16 CFR Part 464 (464.2 total price; 464.3 fees) (N71-R05); FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(a) (N71-R05); ADA Title III 28 CFR 36.302(f)(3) accessible seating price parity; state surveillance-pricing laws not applicable while no personal data is used
status: In production since 2026-03 (46 Hall shows); approved with conditions 2026-08-31; conditions due 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-30

use_case: Bot detection and virtual queue: scores each session in high-demand on-sales, then allows, challenges, or blocks it, and randomizes queue position
vendor_or_model: Ticketing platform vendor (machine-learning risk scoring and queue module in SYS-01)
source_evidence: EV-032 (module settings); EV-026 (vendor system description); EV-062 (on-sale reports)
data_categories: Device and browser signals, network address and network type, request timing, account age; session records kept 30 days by the vendor
consequential_decision_category: None (access to one on-sale; box office and phone remain open)
human_in_the_loop: Automated per-session decisions; humans handle appeals and releases (logged) and review linked-account evidence before any order cancellation
applicable_laws: BOTS Act 15 U.S.C. 45c (protects the company as a ticket issuer); Fla. Stat. 817.36(5); FTC Act Section 5 15 U.S.C. 45(a) posted-limit and privacy statements (N71-R05); ADA Title III 28 CFR 36.302(f)(1)(ii) equal opportunity during the same stages of sale
status: In production since 2024; approved with conditions 2026-08-31; conditions due 2026-09-30 to 2026-12-31
